visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male character with dyed blonde hair and black-framed glasses appears in a medium shot, wearing a maroon textured sweater featuring a teddy bear illustration. He holds a red rectangular Louis Vuitton box in a brightly lit, minimalist indoor setting with white walls and soft recessed lighting. (2) The character performs an unboxing action, revealing a green magnetic interior holding multiple red packets adorned with intricate gold patterns. He holds one packet close to the camera, showing a snake-like motif. The background remains a clean, high-end residential interior with neutral tones and a minimalist sofa. (3) Switching focus to a second box, the character reveals a light-colored wooden jointed object with LV monogram patterns, initially appearing like a series of blocks. He manipulates the object with his hands, showing its flexible nature while smiling broadly in a medium close-up, highlighting the texture of the wood and the printed logos. (4) The scene shifts to a full shot as the character moves energetically around the room, wearing red and white checkered pajama pants. He swings the wooden snake toy like a whip, performing exaggerated martial arts poses and dancing. The lighting is consistent and bright throughout this montage of playful movements, showcasing the depth of the room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male voice greets the audience over a fast-tempo, upbeat pop BGM with a driving synth beat. The vocal delivery is sharp and enunciated. Minimal background noise is audible, suggesting a quiet indoor recording environment. A faint rustle of clothing and the red box being handled occurs. (2) The vocal intensity remains high as the speaker describes the gift. A distinct "snap" sound occurs as the magnetic box lid opens, followed by the crisp sound of paper red packets being shuffled. The BGM maintains a steady, driving rhythm with high arousal levels. (3) A synthesized "whoosh" sound effect marks a transition. The speaker's tone becomes more inquisitive and comedic. A series of percussive wooden "clacks" are heard as the jointed LV toy is unfolded, creating a rhythmic resonance that overlaps with the speaker's laughing narration. (4) The audio becomes highly dynamic with the speaker shouting rhythmic vocalizations imitating martial arts. These high-arousal vocal bursts are punctuated by continuous rapid wooden clacking sounds. The BGM remains celebratory and loud until a final vocal appeal for comments.
